sourceScope.kind: retained client configuration and native/Lua consumer cohort

orderedRequirementsHash.ordering: Preserve profile row order and every source prerequisite array entry in its original order. No whitespace, BOM, or trailing newline in hash input.

semantics.profileSelector: PlayerModule.GetFunctionAB("building") == 1 selects full ReqBuilding list; all other values select full ReqBuildingD list. ReqBuildingB is not selected by this consumer.
semantics.combination: AND across all selected list entries, demonstrated both by boolean accumulator in get_CheckBuildingConditions and fail-fast full-list enumeration in UpGradeReqBuildingEnough.
semantics.threshold: Each entry is resolved to Building Type and Level. Any retained city-tile instance for that type with current level >= target level satisfies that individual entry.
semantics.rank: Target record rank is preserved in the audit/model identity; reviewed native predicate passes Type and Level, not rank as a separate argument.
semantics.nullList: UpGradePreConditionsEnough and UpGradeReqBuildingEnough return true for null prerequisite list; this does not bypass distinct feature/mission/item/visibility gates.
semantics.liveScope: Static retained client cohort only. No current server/account assignment, future hotfix, or full live unlock eligibility is established.

constructionItems.kind: item quantities, not additional building references

populationSlots.kind: population/work-slot capacity consumed by population allocation and restaurant modules; not a Buildings reference

featureGates.kind: separate initial feature availability, not a Buildings prerequisite

groundUnlockAndVisibility.selector: BuildingGroundUnlockConditionReal uses independent new_user_experience a/b assignment, not GetFunctionAB("building").

initialGradePath.kind: separate Power Plant grade/initial level-0-to-1 path; its ReqBuildingD references BuildingsGrade, not Buildings. Not appended to normal level upgrade requirements.

furnitureProgress.kind: separate furniture progression helper; marked furniture levels feed GetBuildingFurnitureProgress and HasUpgradeAllBuildingConditionFurnitures. Not additional named-building references. Full live upgrade gating applicability is not established.

luaConsumerPins.role: FurniturePeopleModule furniture progress and condition helper
Population allocation slots; BuildSlotSoc is a slot count

unconfirmedScope: The user account/server assignment to Original or D is unknown; public labels A/B are presentation labels and do not establish assignment.
Live mission, ground/foundation, feature, item-ownership, furniture and initial-grade eligibility is not inferred from a configured building prerequisite list.
Refinery level 1 and Laboratory 2 level 1 retain their pre-existing incomplete-initial-condition calculation guards; empty ReqBuilding arrays do not establish free construction.
The separate BuildingGroundUnlockCondition new_user_experience variants are not combined with the building cost/requirement profile selector.
ReqBuildingB is retained and independently decoded but is not selected by the reviewed get_RequireBuildings consumer.
Star/rank branches, higher-level records, server age, season activation and future patches outside the existing 22-route/29-ID/1,522-row projection are not added or declared live.
The reviewed native per-entry predicate compares building Type and Level; record rank is preserved for identity but is not passed as a separate predicate argument.
